text: Keisha's housewarming is sometime end of the month, she'll confirm the date. Bring a plant, she said the new flat looks bare.
so I was on the phone with Dafydd and his dad passed away on Sunday um the funeral's probably early next week in Bangor I should send flowers the day before
Abigail made redundant. Last day Friday. She's putting a brave face on it but sounded flat. Check in w her sometime next week
Zhang and his wife Mei are hosting a dinner on the 14th, I'm doing dessert
Rebecca's mum turns 70 in early March, they're doing a big lunch at the golf club. Rebecca is stressing about the seating plan already

Dawit split up with his gf Hana. Been together 6 yrs, they'd just started looking at houses. He found out she'd been seeing someone from work since the summer. Staying at his brother Yonas's for now, sleeping on the sofa, and his mum keeps ringing him every night which isn't helping. Take him for a pint sometime next week and don't mention Hana unless he does
lachlan's engagement party cancelled - Fi's dad in hospital again
Aoife told me her nan's funeral is Thursday, then a wake at the pub afterwards. She asked if I'd come. I'm going, booked the afternoon off.
Connor - new job at the council starts after half term. His wife Tara is due in Feb!! Remind me to send congrats card

Sadia's brother Imran is getting married over the summer somewhere in Lahore, whole family flying out for two weeks. Mehndi the night before, then the nikah, then the walima a couple of days after. She's nervous about the speech she has to give at the mehndi because half the guests don't speak English and her aunties will judge her Urdu. Offered to listen to a practice run.
Krisztina invited me to her 40th, Saturday the 8th, fancy dress 80s theme. Need to sort a costume the week before
Ilse's dog Biscuit had to be put down yesterday. She's gutted. Text her tomorrow

Coffee with Naledi. Her mum's moving in with them sometime in the new year, they're converting the garage into a granny flat with its own little kitchen. Her kids Thabo and Lerato are thrilled, Naledi less so lol. Her mum has early Parkinson's so it makes sense, she just worries about losing her own space. Builders start early January.
gustavo leaving do thurs at the Crown, drinks from 6. I'll go after the dentist
Lucy's grandad's memorial is a week after the cremation, sometime around the 20th. Family only for the first bit. Don't forget to ask her how the cremation went
Yuki got laid off along with half her team. Says she's fine and wants to take the summer off and travel. Her partner Kenji is freaking out more than her.
Lars + Pieter's anniversary dinner next Fri, they've invited a few of us. Lars hinted they want nice wine glasses, the old ones all broke at the move

Gabriel's mum had a stroke last week. She's out of hospital now but can't really use her left hand, and his dad isn't coping on his own. Gabriel is back and forth to Leeds every weekend and his boss is already being funny about it. He looked shattered. Must ring him Sunday evening when he's driving back.
Dictated walking home: Lila's having a bonfire night party on the 5th, starts at 7. Her husband Tom does the fireworks. Bring sparklers for the kids and maybe a bottle of something.
Mihai - mum's 60th, surprise do in Bucharest late November. Hush hush. He wants me to help pick a present, she loves gardening
reggie's uncle died. funeral next wednesday, he's a pallbearer and dreading it. text him that morning

Chantal and her ex Darren finally divorced, took nearly two years. She's moving to Bristol end of the month with the kids to be near her parents, new job at the uni there too. The house sale completes the day before the move so it's going to be tight. Offer to help pack the weekend before, and maybe drive the second van down.
Ivan said the christening is on the 2nd, lunch at his in-laws afterwards. I'm godparent so need to get something silver
Call with Andre. His sister Bianca broke up with her fiance three weeks before the wedding. Venue deposit gone. Andre's raging on her behalf. Their mum is trying to get some of it back.
Yosef had his redundancy meeting this morning. Waiting to hear sometime next week whether it's voluntary or compulsory. Ask how it went
Karim's birthday drinks Saturday, he's mid 30s crisis apparently ha. Wants a record player
Vanessa invited us to her housewarming in early December. Her partner Jo is doing a curry night thing. Vanessa is vegan btw, Jo isn't
Magda's dad's funeral was yesterday. I couldn't make it. Need to message her today and maybe drop round some food over the weekend
Hoang and Lucy are doing a joint birthday thing over the summer, probably July, BBQ at Hoang's mum's place
Book MOT, pick up dry cleaning, cancel gym
spoke w Abigail again, the redundancy pay came through. She's got an interview at a charity the day after her last day!! Wish her luck the night before
Mrs Williams next door lost her husband Ron over the weekend. Ambulance came Saturday night. I should knock and see if she needs anything, maybe Wednesday
Dafydd sent the funeral details: Tuesday 11am at the chapel, tea after at his aunt's. He asked me to do a reading. Practise it the night before
Keisha said her sister Aaliyah is moving back from Dubai sometime in the spring. Keisha can't wait, they're super close.
Note to self: dinner at Zhang's went really well. His son Leo is applying to med school, interview sometime in December. Zhang is more nervous than Leo is lol
rebecca came round. Her husband Matt lost his job at the bank, third round of cuts. They've cancelled the ski trip. She's worried about the mortgage. Check in on her end of next week
Dawit doing a bit better, started climbing again and went to a gig with his mates on Fri. Seeing a counsellor now too.
Lachlan Hughes aka Lachie - new date for the engagement do, early spring once Fi's dad is home. Plan a gift sometime before
um Aoife's mum is having her knee replaced the week after Christmas and Aoife's going home to Cork to look after her for a fortnight so I need to remember to ask how the op went afterwards
Connor's twins start reception next September. Him and Tara looking at schools now, open days over the next few weeks
Sadia mentioned her husband Faisal is a huge Arsenal fan, been a season ticket holder since uni. Good gift idea for his 40th
Krisztina's 40th: venue moved to her sister's garden. Still the 8th. Bring a chair
Called Ilse. She's bearing up. Her partner Rob took a few days off to be with her. They might get a rescue dog in the summer, not yet though
Naledi's husband Sipho starts his PhD in January! Commuting to Cape Town twice a month. Congratulate him when I see him at the braai sunday
Gustavo's farewell got moved to the Thursday after, the Crown was double booked. Same time.
Yuki's partner Kenji invited me to their Diwali party on the 1st, she's cooking, he's doing a quiz. Bring sweets from the Indian shop

Lars rang. Says Pieter's mum died suddenly last month, heart attack at home, and Pieter's not coping at all. Barely sleeping, not eating properly, signed off work for a fortnight. He flew out to Rotterdam for the funeral and came back worse. Lars is worried and asked me to keep an eye on him since they're both at work all day. Must invite Pieter for a walk sometime this week.
Gabriel's brother Rafa is getting married in Lisbon over Easter, Gabriel is best man and terrified of the speech. Send him a good luck text the morning of
Lila's book club is doing The Bee Sting next. Lila loves Irish authors and anything by Claire Keegan
Mihai's mum's surprise party went great by all accounts. Ask him for the photos
Reggie said the funeral was lovely in the end, lots of laughs at the wake. He's taking a few days off afterwards to sort his uncle's flat. Text him Friday
Dr Barros said the results come back sometime next week, then we'll know whether I need the second scan
Chantal's eldest Jade is struggling with the move, refusing to go to the new school. Chantal is exhausted. Ask her how Jade's first week went
Ivan's in-laws are throwing a big lunch on the Sunday after the christening, the day after, and they've asked me to say a few words as godparent. I'm saying yes

Long chat with Andre after squash. His company is restructuring and he thinks his whole department will be cut by the end of the year. He's not sleeping well and his partner Nadia just went back to work after maternity leave so money's tight. He's applying for jobs quietly, has a first interview at a fintech in early November. I said I'd look over his CV this weekend, and remind me to text him the day before the interview.

Yosef update: it's compulsory, not voluntary. Last day end of the month, then three months' pay. His wife Rachel's being amazing apparently and her dad has offered to help with the mortgage for a bit. He wants to retrain as a teacher, maths, PGCE starting next September. He seemed oddly relieved. Send him that link about the teacher training bursary.
Karim's drinks were fun, his girlfriend Leila's lovely. They're off to Japan for three weeks in March

Vanessa's housewarming is off - the sale fell through at the last minute, buyer's mortgage got pulled the day before exchange. She's gutted and stuck in the rental till at least early spring. Jo is trying to stay positive but they'd already given notice and now have to beg the landlord to extend. Send her something nice, maybe a voucher for that vegan place she likes.

Magda's mum is coming over from Gdansk for a month to stay with her, arriving sometime next week, first visit since the funeral. Magda says she's a brilliant cook and wants to feed everyone, so we're invited for pierogi on the Saturday after she lands. Her mum doesn't eat pork anymore, heart stuff, so bring something without. Magda seemed lighter talking about it.
Hoang's cat Pho went missing on Monday, back by Wednesday night thank god. Hoang said his daughter Linh cried for two days
